filename: Explaining South Asian Monsoon Rainfall Seasonality Using a Metric of Plume Buoyancy.pdf
title: Stress-Testing a Process-Oriented Diagnostic Relating Tropical Rainfall to Plume Buoyancy
testbed_rationale: The study does not develop machine learning models or generate high-resolution benchmark simulations; it tests an existing process-oriented thermodynamic diagnostic against observational/reanalysis data.
pain_points: Subregional (500-1,000 km) and monthly scale variations in the precipitation-buoyancy relationship lead to systematic underpredictions (18-90%) of domain-mean rainfall changes.
Potential sampling noise and breakdown of the temporally constant precipitation-buoyancy relationship assumption at localized scales.
extraction_notes: The preprint cover page lists the title as 'Explaining South Asian Monsoon Rainfall Seasonality Using a Metric of Plume Buoyancy', but the main manuscript title is 'Stress-Testing a Process-Oriented Diagnostic Relating Tropical Rainfall to Plume Buoyancy'. No machine learning algorithms are trained or evaluated in this study.
